Good to know

Huck's American Craft — UGA game-day specials — ask at the bar.

Mama's on the Half Shell — Happy hour is 1st floor, indoors only.

Hudson Street Stackhouse — Happy hour times are published by the venue, but no prices are currently listed by the venue.

Silks — Soccer matchday pricing: $15 buckets, $3 Ultra drafts, $4 Stella, $5 NUTRLs.

The Dive — Happy hour (“that 70’s hour”) published on Instagram; Friday daytime window is new.

Lee's Pint & Shell — First Wednesday of the month: $5.99 build-your-own 11 oz. double cheeseburger.

Claddagh Pub — All prices are subject to change without notice.

Sports Balls @ The Canton Local — Weekly specials on the official QR menu: $16 burger+draft Mon/Fri, $.99 wing night Wednesday, $16 Reuben and draft Thursday.

SoPro (Southern Provisions Bar + Kitchen) — Wednesday: pick 3 specialty cheesesteaks for $15. Happy hour is advertised Mon–Fri 4–7pm but drink prices are not listed on the graphic.

The Point in Fells — Happy hour days and times are published by the venue; their prices appear only in images we do not read.

Blackwall Hitch — Advertises happy hour Monday to Friday 3-6pm; prices are not published on their website.

The Outpost — Happy hour times published; prices not listed.

Azumi — Happy hour is inside bar only.

Sugarvale — Sunday: happy hour prices all night.

The Coral Wig — Mondays: industry specials and happy hour prices all night.

Magdalena — At The Ivy Hotel. Happy hour drinks Tue–Fri 4:30–6:30.

Bar Dalí — Vermouth hour Mon–Thu 4–6.

Alma Cocina Latina — Happy hour is at the bar only. Closed Mon–Tue. Prices not published on the current happy-hour page.

Wicked Sisters — Happy hour weekdays 3–6 at the bar and on the patio.

The Bluebird — Cocktail Room happy hour Mon–Fri 5:00–6:30.

Of Love & Regret — Happy hour times published; food/drink prices not currently listed on the website.

Baltimore Seafood — Daily boil specials plus happy hour (no Saturday; none on holidays).

The Barn & Lodge at The Rotunda — Daily specials (Mon/Tue/Wed) are dine-in only, not available for carryout, and can't be combined with any other offer. Their daily-specials page also describes Gathering Hour as at the bar.

Phillips Seafood — Happy hour is bar and lounge only, Monday–Friday 3–6pm.

Cinghiale — Cellar Raid is Enoteca or bar during lunch and dinner.

Facci Ristorante — Happy hour is at the bar only, 3–6pm daily.

Fogo de Chao — All-day drink happy hour is at Bar Fogo. Half-price South American wine bottles under $130 are in the dining room and bar.

The Food Market — Happy hour is bar only, Monday–Friday 4–6pm.

Gertrude's Restaurant — Thursday $20 dinners. Boardwalk Crab Cake is a $5 upcharge. No discounts or substitutions.

Guilford Hall Brewery — Kitchen hours conclude 1 hour before close.

Hersh's Pizza & Drinks — Wine Wednesday half-off bottles is with dinner.

iBar — Friday is listed as Ladies' Night. Wednesday Wingsday and Saturday College Night require valid college ID.

Johnny Rad's Pizzeria Tavern — Monday $14 large pies are dine-in only, with a drink. Friday–Saturday late-night BOGO cans/bottles is dine-in only.

La Calle — Happy hour times published; item prices not currently listed on the checked page.

La Cuchara — Bar happy hour.

Valentino's Restaurant — In-House only / Excluding Holidays.

McCormick & Schmick's — Not available for carryout. Not valid on holidays. Minimum beverage purchase of $3.4 per person.

Mt. Washington Tavern — Thursday complimentary oysters require a food or drink purchase.

Estiatorio Plaka — bar only

Swallow at the Hollow — Kitchen closes 10pm Sun–Wed, 11pm Thu–Sat.

The Hamilton Sports Bar & Grill — Until they run out; one order per person

Warehouse Cinemas Rotunda — 50% off any beverage from our one-of-a-kind self-serve tap wall

Woodberry Kitchen — Dinner Wednesday–Saturday 5:00–9:30 p.m.

Yeiboh Kitchen — Happy hour menu only available at the bar & back patio

Nine Tailed Fox — Happy hour is bar only.

Fadensonnen — Happy hour Tuesday–Thursday 5–7pm. Site does not list happy hour prices. Winter hours: Tue–Thu 5pm–11pm, Fri 5pm–12am, Sat 1pm–12am, Sun 1pm–11pm.

Gunther & Co. — Happier Hour Tue–Fri from open until 7pm in the Gunther Bar.

Little Havana — Happy hour is bar only, Monday–Friday 4–6pm.

Barcocina — Happy hour Mon–Fri 3–6pm on the official flyer. Weekly $8 tequila shot is listed all day, every day (shots only).

Blue Agave Mexican Food — Happy hour Mon–Fri 4–7pm, bar and patio only; bar and dining room on Tuesdays. Margarita prices are listed as three serving sizes (1/4/6).

The Cannon Room — Whiskey Workshop Sundays at 5:00pm, $102 per person. Half-priced bottles Tuesdays 5:00pm–10:00pm.

Frazier's on the Avenue — Hours on site: Mon–Fri 11am–2am, Sat–Sun 9am–2am. Happy hour Mon–Fri 3–7pm.

Peabody Heights Brewery — Happy hour every Wednesday 4–6pm: $2 off pints and 25% off appetizers (event page). Taproom hours: Mon 4–9pm, Tue–Thu 4–10pm, Fri 4–11pm, Sat 12–10pm, Sun 12–8pm.

Monument City Brewing — Thursday neighborhood happy hour: $5 pours; event lists 4–9pm. Taproom: Thu–Fri 4–10pm, Sat 12–10pm, Sun 12–6pm; closed Mon–Wed.
